### 1. Scene
A mixed dinner plate with roast meats, a chicken drumstick, browned cheese, leafy salad, broccoli, potatoes and courgette.

### 2. Vessel
A large, roughly square dinner plate, partly cropped. I’ll approximate its usable area as a **26 cm round plate**:  
**3.14 × 13² = 531 cm².**

### 3–7. Items, area, volume, weight and energy
The browned white piece at the top right appears to be grilled halloumi; the other meat appears to be roast pork. Both identifications are uncertain.

| Visible item | Plate area | Area × height = gross volume | Bulk density | Estimated weight | kcal/100 g | kcal |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Mixed salad leaves | 24% | 127 × 3 = 381 ml | 0.15 | 57 g | 20 | 11 |
| Grilled halloumi-like cheese | 9% | 48 × 0.9 = 43 ml | 0.95 | 41 g | 320 | 131 |
| Roast meat, likely pork | 10% | 53 × 1.3 = 69 ml | 1.0 | 69 g | 200 | 138 |
| Chicken drumstick, bone-in | 12% | 64 × 1.7 = 109 ml | 0.95 | 103 g | 170* | 175 |
| Broccoli | 12% | 64 × 2.5 = 160 ml | 0.50 | 80 g | 35 | 28 |
| Yellow potato pieces | 12% | 64 × 1.7 = 109 ml | 0.65 | 71 g | 115 | 82 |
| Courgette pieces | 7% | 37 × 1.3 = 48 ml | 0.60 | 29 g | 35 | 10 |
| Visible cooking oil/coating | Overlapping | Approximately 7 ml | 0.92 | 6 g | 884 | 53 |

*Chicken energy is expressed per bone-in plated weight, allowing for the visible bone. Oil is counted separately rather than included in the vegetable energy values.*

### 8. Sanity check
The food footprints total **86%** of the plate area. Approximately **556 g and 730 kcal** is plausible for this crowded dinner plate. The main uncertainties are the cheese identification, meat cuts and amount of cooking oil.
